The climate in Vlorë

Vlorë is about 5 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 32°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 5°C. Around 1030 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 163 mm). The highest temperature in Vlorë in 2015–2024 was 42°C (25 July 2023) and the lowest −6°C (8 January 2017).

Best time to visit Vlorë

The most pleasant weather in Vlorë is usually in May, September and October: average highs are between 23°C and 27°C, with up to 9 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
